mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods with a sustained decline in RSAFS over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (proxied by INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a month signals a strengthening demand side, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases & UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over a month signals inflationary pressure with accommodative monetary policy, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases & CPIAUCSL increases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases simultaneously in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods with a sustained increase in PAYEMS over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% in a quarter signals a weakening economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 decreases by more than 1% in a quarter.
